A_category_tree.name: Raw Materials - Bulk & Commodity Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: High volume, low margin, spec-interchangeable. Tanker / ISO tank / bag / IBC. Buy on landed cost + reliability.

A_category_tree.name: Feedstocks & Petrochemical Base
A_category_tree.note: Solvent naphtha, methanol, toluene, xylene, acetone, MEG/DEG, glycerine, phenol, formalin, EO/PO derivatives, fatty acids, fatty alcohols. Mostly DG Class 3.

A_category_tree.name: Mineral Acids
A_category_tree.note: Hydrochloric 33%, sulphuric 98%, nitric 68%, phosphoric 85% tech/food. DG Class 8, storage class SC-1.

A_category_tree.name: Alkalis
A_category_tree.note: Caustic soda flakes 98% / lye 47-50%, potassium hydroxide, soda ash light & dense. DG Class 8, storage class SC-2.

A_category_tree.name: Salts & Inorganic Compounds
A_category_tree.note: Sodium sulphate, bicarbonate, metabisulphite, hypochlorite 12.5%, alum, PAC, ferric chloride, lime, zinc oxide, titanium dioxide.

A_category_tree.name: Industrial Gases
A_category_tree.note: Nitrogen, oxygen, argon, CO2, hydrogen, LPG, acetylene, calibration mixes. Cylinder / dewar / bulk. DG Class 2, storage SC-5.

A_category_tree.name: Solvents
A_category_tree.note: Best entry category: high repeat purchase, clear specs, strong price opacity.

A_category_tree.name: Hydrocarbon & Aliphatic Solvents
A_category_tree.note: Hexane, heptane, kerosene, white spirit, D40/D60/D80, isoparaffins. DG Class 3, SC-3.

A_category_tree.name: Oxygenated Solvents
A_category_tree.note: Methanol, ethanol (denatured/absolute/ENA), IPA, butanol, ethyl & butyl acetate, MEK, MIBK, acetone. DG Class 3.

A_category_tree.name: Glycol Ethers & High Boilers
A_category_tree.note: 2-ethylhexanol, DPM, TPM, glycol ether families. Lower volatility, some combustible rather than flammable.

A_category_tree.name: Halogenated Solvents
A_category_tree.note: Methylene chloride, chloroform, TCE. Several are restricted/authorisation-gated - catalogue must carry a restricted flag and buyer acknowledgement.

A_category_tree.name: Green & Bio-based Solvents
A_category_tree.note: d-limonene, ethyl lactate, methyl soyate, glycerol formal, dibasic esters. Fastest-growing solvent sub-segment on ESG demand.

A_category_tree.name: Commodity Thermoplastics
A_category_tree.note: HDPE/LDPE/LLDPE, PP homo & copolymer, PS, EPS, ABS, PET. Sold by grade + MFI.

A_category_tree.name: Engineering Plastics
A_category_tree.note: PA6/PA66, PC, POM, PBT, PMMA, PPS, PEEK, PVDF, PTFE. Higher margin, spec-critical.

A_category_tree.name: PVC & Plasticisers
A_category_tree.note: Suspension PVC, CPVC, DOP/DOTP/DINP/ATBC. Some plasticisers phasing out - track restriction lists.

A_category_tree.name: Thermoset Resins
A_category_tree.note: Epoxy resin + hardeners, unsaturated polyester, phenolic, PU systems (MDI/TDI/polyol). Isocyanates are hazardous - SC-6 handling.

A_category_tree.name: Elastomers & Rubber
A_category_tree.note: Natural rubber, SBR, NBR, EPDM, silicone gum, reclaimed rubber.

A_category_tree.name: Recycled & Bio-based Polymers
A_category_tree.note: rPET, rPP, regrind, PLA, PHA, bio-PE. Growing on ESG mandates; requires traceability of recycled content.

A_category_tree.name: Bulk Additives, Fillers & Pigments
A_category_tree.note: GCC/PCC, talc, kaolin, fumed & precipitated silica, barium sulphate, mica, wollastonite, carbon black, TiO2, iron oxides, organic & inorganic pigments, masterbatches.

A_category_tree.name: Raw Materials - Specialty & Formulated Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: Lower volume, higher margin, function-driven, harder to substitute. Qualification, not just price.

A_category_tree.name: Surfactants & Detergent Bases
A_category_tree.note: LABSA 90%, SLES 70% (2EO/3EO), SLS, AES, CAPB, AEO, APG, alcohol ethoxylates, sulfosuccinates, amine oxides, quats (BTC/DDAC), gemini & silicone surfactants.

A_category_tree.name: Polymer Additives
A_category_tree.note: Antioxidants, UV stabilisers, HALS, heat stabilisers, flame retardants (APP/ATH/brominated/phosphorus), nucleating agents, slip & antiblock.

A_category_tree.name: Processing Aids
A_category_tree.note: Compatibilisers, coupling agents, defoamers, dispersants, rheology modifiers, biocides, preservatives (MIT/CMIT, phenoxyethanol), antistats.

A_category_tree.name: Functional Fillers & Nanomaterials
A_category_tree.note: Nanosilica, nanoclay, CNT, graphene. Low volume, high value, sample-heavy, nano-specific safety data required.

A_category_tree.name: Coatings, Ink & Adhesive Raw Materials
A_category_tree.note: Alkyds, acrylics, PU dispersions, nitrocellulose, rosins, TiO2, extenders, coalescents, thickeners (HEC/ASE/HEUR), pigments & dyes, photoinitiators, UV monomers & oligomers.

A_category_tree.name: Water Treatment & Process Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: RECOMMENDED FIRST CATEGORY. Coagulants (alum/PAC/ferric), flocculants (anionic/cationic/nonionic PAM), antiscalants, corrosion inhibitors, oxygen scavengers, biocides, pH adjusters, IX resins, activated carbon, membrane cleaners, chelants, boiler & cooling tower treatment.

A_category_tree.name: Industrial & Institutional Cleaning
A_category_tree.note: Alkaline cleaners, acid descalers, solvent degreasers, CIP detergents & sanitisers, foam control, laundry, handwash & sanitisers, floor care, enzymatic cleaners.

A_category_tree.name: Textile, Leather, Paper & Pulp Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: Sizing agents, wet-strength resins, retention aids, optical brighteners, dye-fixing agents, tanning agents (incl. chrome-free), fatliquors, defoamers, bleaching stabilisers, softener bases.

A_category_tree.name: Food, Feed & Personal Care Ingredients
A_category_tree.note: GRADE-GATED. Acidulants, preservatives, sweeteners, hydrocolloids, emulsifiers, vitamins, amino acids, flavours, colours, cosmetic actives, emollients, waxes, silicones. Requires food/pharma/cosmetic grade cert + allergen declaration + batch traceability.

A_category_tree.name: Oils, Lubricants & Metalworking Fluids
A_category_tree.note: Base oils (Group I-III, PAO, esters), greases, hydraulic & gear oils, compressor & transformer oils, metalworking fluids (soluble/semi-synthetic/neat), quenching oils, rust preventives, heat transfer fluids.

A_category_tree.name: Adhesives & Sealants (Finished)
A_category_tree.note: Epoxies, PU, silicones, cyanoacrylates, hot-melts & EVA, PVAc, MS polymers, anaerobics, tapes.

A_category_tree.name: Construction & Infrastructure Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: Concrete admixtures (PCE, lignosulphonate, naphthalene), waterproofing, grouts, repair mortars, tile adhesives, curing compounds, protective coatings, geochemicals.

A_category_tree.name: Agrochemicals & Plant Nutrition
A_category_tree.note: LICENCE-GATED. NPK & water-soluble fertilisers, micronutrients, insecticides/fungicides/herbicides, PGRs, biostimulants, soil conditioners. Verify seller AND buyer licences before enabling transactions.

A_category_tree.name: Laboratory & Reagent Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: AR/LR grades, analytical standards, reference materials, indicators, buffer salts, chromatography media, HPLC/GC-grade solvents, titration reagents.

A_category_tree.name: Pharma & Fine Chemicals
A_category_tree.note: HIGHEST COMPLIANCE BURDEN. APIs, pharma intermediates, excipients (MCC, lactose, starch, Mg stearate), bio-buffers. GMP docs, CEP/DMF, country licences. Enter only with a regulatory partner.

A_category_tree.name: Catalysts, Enzymes & Biotech Inputs
A_category_tree.note: Precious-metal & base-metal catalysts, zeolites, supported catalysts, industrial enzymes (amylase/protease/lipase/cellulase), fermentation media & nutrients, starter cultures.

A_category_tree.name: Machines & Process Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Capex. Long cycle, high value. Sell as brokerage + escrow + third-party inspection, not marketplace inventory.

A_category_tree.name: Reaction, Mixing & Blending Equipment
A_category_tree.note: SS316 / glass-lined / jacketed reactors, agitated vessels, high-shear mixers, planetary mixers, homogenisers, ribbon & conical blenders, dissolvers, bead/ball/hammer mills, crystallisers, evaporators, spray dryers.

A_category_tree.name: Separation, Filtration & Drying Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Distillation columns & internals, wiped-film evaporators, filter press / Nutsche / candle filters, decanter & basket & disc-stack centrifuges, hydrocyclones, extraction units, tray/FBD/vacuum/flash dryers, UF/NF/RO skids, dust collectors.

A_category_tree.name: Heat Transfer & Thermal Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Shell & tube / plate heat exchangers, cooling towers, chillers, thermic fluid heaters, industrial ovens & furnaces, steam boilers, heat recovery, jacketed piping & tracing.

A_category_tree.name: Fluid Handling, Transfer & Storage
A_category_tree.note: Centrifugal, gear, AODD diaphragm, lobe, peristaltic, screw, magnetic-drive sealless pumps (correct for corrosive/flammable duty); ball/gate/butterfly/diaphragm/pinch/safety-relief valves; hose & couplings; IBCs, drums, silos, agitators, level & containment.

A_category_tree.name: Instrumentation, Control & Automation
A_category_tree.note: Flow (magnetic/coriolis/ultrasonic), level (radar/ultrasonic/float), pressure & temperature transmitters, analytical (pH/ORP/conductivity/turbidity/DO), control valves & actuators, PLC/DCS, HMI/SCADA, VFDs, load cells, gas detection & safety interlocks.

A_category_tree.name: Filling, Packaging & Labelling Lines
A_category_tree.note: Drum & IBC filling stations, bottling & capping, sachet FFS, carton sealers, shrink-wrap, palletisers, labellers, metal detectors, checkweighers, coders & printers.

A_category_tree.name: Material Handling Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Forklifts (electric/diesel), stackers, pallet trucks, conveyors, hoists & EOT cranes, industrial vacuum, AGVs.

A_category_tree.name: Utilities, Energy & Effluent Treatment
A_category_tree.note: Air compressors & dryers, N2/O2 generators, RO & DM plants, ETP/STP equipment (clarifiers, DAF, MBBR media), sludge dewatering, incinerators, solar thermal, UPS & generators.

A_category_tree.name: Laboratory & QC Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Fume hoods, hotplates & stirrers, ovens & muffle furnaces, viscometers, spectrophotometers, HPLC/GC, titrators, particle size analysers, moisture analysers, balances, colour measurement.

A_category_tree.name: Line-Specific Process Machinery
A_category_tree.note: The vertical bundles - detergent & liquid washing lines, paint dispersion lines, food processing lines, cosmetic cream/lotion lines, plastic compounding & extrusion, water bottling, blending & packaging skids. This is where 'we sell the line' becomes literal.

A_category_tree.name: Used, Refurbished & Rental Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Second-hand reactors & centrifuges, refurbished instruments, rental dosing skids & temporary utilities. High margin, underserved, natural fit for escrow + inspection.

A_category_tree.name: Consumables, MRO & Packaging
A_category_tree.note: Low unit value, highest order frequency, creates daily engagement. Availability beats price here.

A_category_tree.name: Packaging Materials
A_category_tree.note: HDPE & steel drums (200/210/220 L), IBCs, jerry cans 5-30 L, PP/PE bags & FIBCs, liners, drum bungs/caps/rings/seals, pails & tubs, bottles & closures, sachet film, shrink & stretch film, corrugated, wooden & plastic pallets, strapping & tapes. UN-rated packaging is mandatory for DG fills.

A_category_tree.name: PPE & Safety Equipment
A_category_tree.note: Nitrile/latex/neoprene/butyl & chemical gauntlets, coveralls (Type 3/4/5/6), respirators (half/full mask, PAPR, cartridges), safety shoes & boots, face shields, goggles, chemical aprons, spill kits, eyewash & safety showers, first aid, LOTO, portable gas detectors.

A_category_tree.name: Filtration & Separation Consumables
A_category_tree.note: Filter bags (PP/PE/PTFE, 1-800 um), cartridge filters, filter cloths & plates, RO/UF membranes & spares, activated carbon, filter aid (diatomite, perlite), sieve & screen meshes.

A_category_tree.name: Gaskets, Seals & Hose
A_category_tree.note: Spiral-wound & ring-joint gaskets, EPDM/NBR/Viton/PTFE seals, O-ring kits, hose assemblies, quick couplings. Chemical compatibility chart is the killer merchandising feature.

A_category_tree.name: Electrical & Instrumentation Consumables
A_category_tree.note: Contactors, relays, MCB/MCCB, cables & glands, cable trays, sensors & transmitters, calibrators, indicator lamps.

A_category_tree.name: Maintenance & Workshop Supplies
A_category_tree.note: Industrial adhesives, threadlockers, lubricants & greases, aerosols, cutting & grinding discs, drill bits & taps, abrasives, welding electrodes & wire, paints, cleaners & degreasers, janitorial.

A_category_tree.name: QC & Laboratory Consumables
A_category_tree.note: Glassware, volumetric flasks & pipettes, syringe filters & membranes, reagents, standards, sample containers, lab gloves, wipes, chromatography consumables.

A_category_tree.name: Packing & Despatch Consumables
A_category_tree.note: Labels & thermal ribbons, coding ink, void fill, bubble wrap, edge protectors, desiccants, VCI anti-corrosion packaging.

A_category_tree.name: Services
A_category_tree.note: The services layer is what stops disintermediation. High margin and binds the transaction to the platform.

A_category_tree.name: Sourcing & Brokerage
A_category_tree.note: RFQ management, supplier qualification, factory audits, cost benchmarking, reverse auctions.

A_category_tree.name: Logistics & Dangerous Goods Transport
A_category_tree.note: DG-certified trucking, tank cleaning, hazmat warehousing, ISO tank leasing, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, cargo insurance.

A_category_tree.name: Testing, Inspection & QC
A_category_tree.note: Third-party lab analysis (SGS / Intertek / Bureau Veritas class), pre-shipment inspection, batch retention sampling, CoA verification.

A_category_tree.name: Regulatory & Compliance
A_category_tree.note: SDS authoring & translation, REACH only-representative, TSCA statements, product registration, GHS labelling & classification, HS classification.

A_category_tree.name: Engineering, Installation & After-Sales
A_category_tree.note: Commissioning, AMC/CMC contracts, spares management, operator training, equipment validation.

A_category_tree.name: Trade Finance & Insurance
A_category_tree.note: Supplier credit, invoice discounting, escrow & milestone payment, LC management, product liability cover. Always through a licensed partner.

A_category_tree.name: Waste, Recovery & Circularity
A_category_tree.note: Spent-solvent recovery, effluent treatment services, packaging take-back, chemical destruction & disposal.

A_category_tree.name: Overstock, Off-Spec & Secondary Materials
A_category_tree.note: Underserved supply-side wedge. Every item must carry a deviation disclosure and cannot be recommended for grade-gated end uses (S26, S30, S32).

A_category_tree.name: Surplus & Slow-Moving Stock
A_category_tree.note: Original packaging, documented provenance, near-expiry or slow-moving.

A_category_tree.name: Off-Spec & Downgraded Material
A_category_tree.note: Sold with full CoA deviation disclosure. Platform must block recommendation into grade-gated end uses.

A_category_tree.name: Recovered & Reclaimed Solvents & Oils
A_category_tree.note: Re-distilled solvents, re-refined lubricants. Requires distillation report and residual-contaminant profile.

A_category_tree.name: Recycled Resins, Regrind & Reclaimed Rubber
A_category_tree.note: Regrind, pelletised recyclate, reclaimed rubber. MFI and contamination profile mandatory.

C_attribute_schema.note: Chemical identity; primary key for spec matching
Must validate against the UN Dangerous Goods list. Never free-typed.
Mandatory plain-language statement of what is off-spec
e.g. Ex d IIB T4; mandatory for equipment in flammable atmospheres
e.g. EN 374, EN 166, NIOSH N95, EN ISO 20345
e.g. KNU/g for enzymes, wt% for metal loading
DMF / CEP / ASMF reference for APIs and excipients
Third-party condition report - mandatory for used equipment
Dimension/size string, e.g. 200 L, 25 micron x 7 inch
UN packaging code e.g. 1H1/Y1.8/150; mandatory for DG fills

storage_classes.name: Corrosive acids
storage_classes.rule: Separate bunded area; never with alkalis or hypochlorite

storage_classes.name: Corrosive alkalis
storage_classes.rule: Bunded, dry, away from acids and reactive metals

storage_classes.name: Flammable liquids
storage_classes.rule: Fire-rated store, ATEX electricals, bonding and earthing

storage_classes.name: Oxidisers
storage_classes.rule: Away from flammables and organic material

storage_classes.name: Compressed gases
storage_classes.rule: Upright, chained, ventilated, segregated by gas type

storage_classes.name: Water-reactive materials
storage_classes.rule: Dry store, no water-based fire suppression
